mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, task, provider, outcome, elapsed_ms, input_units, error_message, created_at FROM ai_call_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT kind AS kind, IFNULL(task, '') AS task, outcome AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(elapsed_ms) AS avgElapsedMs, MAX(elapsed_ms) AS maxElapsedMs FROM ai_call_logs WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY kind, task, outcome ORDER BY kind, task, outcome
